sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you invest in our common stock, your ownership interest will be
diluted to the extent of the difference between the public offering price per share and the as-adjusted net tangible book value per share
after this offering. We calculate net tangible book value per share by dividing the net tangible book value, which is tangible assets
less total liabilities, by the number of outstanding shares of our common stock. Dilution with respect to net tangible book value per
share represents the difference between the amount per share paid by purchasers of shares of common stock in this offering and the net
tangible book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering. The net tangible book value of our common stock
as of June 30, 2026, was approximately $(3,408,648), or approximately $(0.24) per share of common stock, based on 14,232,714 shares of
our common stock
